relations: Joan（叙述者/被附身者）；Beatrice（梦中）；Calahan（梦中）；Celia（主卧里破碎的人）

facts.fact: 冬天来了；很久才回到自己（如那夜之后所能）
facts.anchor: The cold curtains of December closed around us.
facts.verbatim: The cold curtains of December closed around us.

facts.fact: 炼狱：Calahan 整段划她的论文，无意识摇头；笔的刮擦响彻耳膜
facts.anchor: The scratches of his pen were loud
facts.verbatim: The scratches of his pen were loud

facts.fact: 她醒悟：他根本没在读；她的想法对他是麻烦；他想安静自肥智识
facts.anchor: Now any time spent engaging with my ideas was a nuisance.
facts.verbatim: Now any time spent engaging with my ideas was a nuisance.

facts.fact: 梦中 Beatrice 端咖啡壶、坐在她亲手做的秋千上（欧扎克倾斜）；「你不在这里」「你是文学」
「我是一套你穿的衣服」——「也许现在你能告诉我：谁是手套、谁是谁的手」
facts.anchor: I’m a suit of clothes you wear.
facts.verbatim: I’m a suit of clothes you wear.

facts.fact: 她脸砸进带刺地板、尝血；呕粉沫、寒战、全然错位
facts.anchor: My face slammed into a splintery floor
facts.verbatim: My face slammed into a splintery floor

facts.fact: 纸垫脸：全被批注、有的被深斜笔迹戳穿；她屈手发僵、脱水——这些页是她写的、毫无记忆
facts.anchor: With no memory whatsoever of doing it.
facts.verbatim: With no memory whatsoever of doing it.

facts.fact: 她在档案馆地板上；低语「Celia」（无力喊）；冰雹敲顶
主卧：你只穿她的大衣、腿上血斑绷带、枯枝在发间——「看着死了」
facts.anchor: You looked dead, your lips cracked and pale.
facts.verbatim: You looked dead, your lips cracked and pale.

facts.fact: 她拖你下床（霉毯雪崩）、扇脸、倾进浴缸泼冰水；你尖叫抓她
「我在流血」「她剖开了我」——但无血；「你看见她了吗？」她撒谎「洞里只有我们」
facts.anchor: It was only us in the cave.
facts.verbatim: It was only us in the cave.

facts.fact: 你搜她目光、缩回、拽上大衣：「出去。请出去」；她出去，水声底下你对墙呢喃
